content.text: Also contraindicated with sGC stimulators such as riociguat (hypotension).

Contraindicated in severe anemia (methemoglobin can worsen it). May aggravate angina from HCM. Severe hypotension can occur even with small doses, especially with aortic or mitral stenosis, constrictive pericarditis, volume depletion or existing hypotension.

severe hypotension, throbbing headache, methemoglobinemia with cyanosis, syncope. No specific antagonist: raise central fluid volume (shock position, IV saline); methylene blue 1–2 mg/kg IV for methemoglobinemia unless G6PD deficiency; epinephrine is ineffective.
